expected_rate: once per Swing lot whose completed daily close reaches entry + 2R (BRK.B qualifies at the first regular-hours cycle after ship)
window_reason: BRK.B's completed close already exceeds +2R, so the first regular-hours cycle after deploy should raise its stop; five sessions allow for a missed or unconfirmed replace
reversal: a Swing lot whose completed close reached entry + 2R still has a resting tier stop below entry + 0.25R (or below bid - $0.01 when the market is lower) after the next session's near-close check without a pending/reprotect_pending page, or any Swing stop lowered by the ratchet, or two live sell stops on one lot

metrics.name: Swing lots at or above +2R whose tier stop sits below entry + 0.25R after the next near-close check
metrics.source: logs/mtf_bot.log ratchet lines + Alpaca open orders for Swing IN- stops vs the Swing lot state
metrics.bound: zero, unless a pending/reprotect page names the lot

metrics.name: Swing stops lowered by the ratchet, or two live own sell stops on one lot
metrics.source: Alpaca order history (replace chain) for Swing IN-/IN-rp- stops

metrics.name: Swing lot fills booked twice or above the lot qty
metrics.source: Swing lot state booked_fills vs Alpaca fills (FIFO)
metrics.bound: zero; any excess is a CRITICAL page, never booked
